classification: research evidence for a retained candidate; not final performance certification, production deployment, public API, or compatibility commitment
purpose: preserve the exact M2 to M3 Rust source delta and the four historical hash versus dense runs behind the retained M3 decision

m2_build_source_manifest.algorithm: sorted build-source records: lowercase SHA-256, TAB, raw byte count, TAB, slash-separated relative path, LF; manifest UTF-8 without BOM

members.role: binary Git patch from base commit to the exact M3 Rust/Cargo build source
binary Git patch from the committed exact M2 source to the exact M3 Rust/Cargo build source

build_source_manifest.algorithm: sorted build-source records: lowercase SHA-256, TAB, raw byte count, TAB, slash-separated relative path, LF; manifest UTF-8 without BOM

binary.name: harness-m3.exe
binary.role: same exact binary for all hash and dense arms
binary.retention: author-local; immutable identity retained here while committed source patches preserve the exact Rust/Cargo build source

external_driver.role: historical Windows run orchestration only; no non-Rust program enters the repository

runs.execution_identity_note: short-prefix did not emit execution_id; order, exact binary, plan, effective result modes, process envelope, and complete output-tree identity bind the run

LF707_BINDING.driver_action: historical driver set LF707_BINDING to the selected hash or dense arm before launch

LF707_BARRIER.driver_action: historical driver fixed LF707_BARRIER to skip for every arm

process.memory_boundary: 250ms polling of process high-water counters; final tail may be missed

source_tree.manifest_rule: UTF-8 lines: relative path, TAB, byte count, TAB, lowercase SHA-256, LF; entries follow ascending PowerShell Sort-Object FullName order

retained.timing_boundary: iteration=advance+buffered semantic output; extended quality, profile CSV, final flush and checkpoints excluded

timing.method: tick >= 65; n=192; p95 linearly interpolates at (n-1)*0.95; stddev uses sample denominator n-1

resource_boundary.boundary: outside iteration/Core timing; cumulative same-zone multi-owner exposure, not geometric collision certification; initial in-zone occupancy may be left-censored
